summary: The Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place scenes and simulations supply local environments, while shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, building, and avatar presentation.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, and Glow Up Salon styling stations.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe-room almond water, shifting walls, creature ecology, and route-guidance moments.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Level 2 uses Tripo props over its collider shell, Level 2.1 has Base Alef and generated rooms.

places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, and climbable library ladders.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - later levels; Level 7 sea/islands and Fort Surrender, Seawatch, modeled wharf/stair, climbable tower ladder and dory; Level 10 silo and Level 11 scaffolding.
places/level26 (3D) - SS Fun =) Adventure liner in green fog with authored ship, decks, wrecked venues, Partygoers, and Phoebe; lower decks reach y=-80 within worldBounds bottom=-110.
places/debug (3D) - mannequin animation/body gallery and HUMAN/FURRY switch pad; places/spamton and remaining configured places are auxiliary/fight spaces or continuing Backrooms routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition; climb.js runs after swim.js.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; main/sim.js owns Level 0 generation and Level 7 sim owns layout/rebuild/tick.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene driver, and BODIES toggle.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 scripts own its route and beats.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD and panels.
places/debug/cells/x1z0.scene + scripts/dbg-pose.js + scripts/dbg-bodypad.js - clip-gallery mannequins and in-world body-style switch.

art/human-base/build.py + art/human-head/* + art/human-face/* + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-hair/build.py + art/tripo-hair/refit.py - offline human rig, heads, morphs, fitted appearance parts, and hair build/refit tools.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings; routing and hub handlers use it for last-level selection and names.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, and weapon definitions/rarity reused by search and combat.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.
scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest, and menu input; scripts/lib/footsteps.js handles player surface stride sounds.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts, and paths reused by place simulations, geometry, and navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + critter.yml + faces.yml + hair.yml + critter-models.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - player/NPC wardrobe, species, deterministic looks, body/head/hair presentation and restyling.
scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml - shared third-person stance and combat animation channels for player and M.E.G. agents; long guns use authored Commando KF rifle clips.
scripts/lib/seat.js - shared chair/sofa/stool seating; interact.js uses standUp for dory exit, with optional land position applied after stand animation.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap and weapon registry.
scripts/lib/l2props.js - PROPS, fitBox, spawnProp, dressRoom, dressHall, containerModel, crateModel.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/footsteps.js - surfaceUnder, stepTick.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec and restyling helpers, STYLE_V.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
places/level7/sim.js - cadence, breakables, tick; scripts/lib/level7-fort2.js - FORT_MATS, TARFIRE, layFort2; scripts/terrain7.js - ISLES, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/climb.js - onInput, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, and wakeAtSave restoration; reload timing is session state.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; target body state.heldBy/down controls hold and release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.
scripts/lib/knock.js - shared physics/timing recovery for down/kb and thrown/overboard records; enemy managers retain AI state and pause it while held or recovering.
scripts/lurkers.js - player.state.lurkHold while caught and lurker entity grab/frenzy/prey state; release clears the player's hold.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim.
scripts/hub.js - mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags plus player trainHid/stungUntil; session.ride/rideTrain holds transient transit scene and spawned train.

scripts/climb.js owns local climb session/player.state.climbing and first-person arm viewmodel; scripts/interact.js/critter.js own salon/wardrobe state and player.js persists look/style; bonus-stylist session orders sitters and writes stylist state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; UI renders mainMenu(ctx, player) when menuOpen.
scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select avatar and restyle occupants via critter-model.js.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings and roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js and mall counters write shop/food state for handlers and UI.
Teleport Station UI in scripts/hub-ui.js renders lastLevel(s) from scripts/lib/hub.js; travel requests reach scripts/hub.js, which boards the player via bc-train and crosses to the destination.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; pickups enter player.js inventory.
L input → scripts/kick.js tries foe kick then loose.js kickLoose; Z input → scripts/grab.js carries/throws eligible bodies and calls loose.js arm/track/impact.
Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; long guns use Commando KF clips and calibrated held-gun transforms.
scripts/climb.js scans ladder-tagged objects, manages attachment/progress and local first-person skin-toned arms; crossing/reload clears a stale climbing hold and restores the weapon.

Bonus salon: mirror-chair seat state + player.state.salonOpen → scripts/salon-stylist.js orders active sitters by arrival, writes bonus-stylist.state.queue and voices waits; scripts/salon-ui.js reads that queue, while dress actions update player appearance.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js - authored mall shops/landmarks with data-driven stock and simulated staff, shoppers, loungers, and arcade games.

places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + art/salon/build.py + scripts/salon-stylist.js + scripts/salon-ui.js - Glow Up Salon shell/furniture and mirror-chair styling stations; Gina serves sitters first-come-first-served, queue state drives wait UI …

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence, and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound, and glow.

places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and zone variants; Level 5 includes portal/quest props, Boiler Room Death Rat packs, fitted residents, and ladder-tagged library climbs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model data + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-head/* + art/human-hair/build.py + art/tripo-hair/refit.py - deterministic human/furry looks and fitted appearance; hair.yml selects refitted, head-fitted pack assets.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared combat channels and human gait with NPC idles, head tracking, fidgets, expressions, and dialogue.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station travel derives from savePlace, with exclusions and tutorial0 mapping handled by hub.js.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; existing weapon ownership/use and non-weapon loot are not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.

Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 4: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them; preserve deterministic route/arrow direction logic. Time 4 Fun poster/door is no longer placed in Level 0.

Footstep surface detection checks visible geometry within 0.45 m before collider; terrain chunk hits use terrain.materialAt. Keep material words/tags and mapping priority in scripts/lib/data/footsteps.yml.

Level 2 l2props.yml sizes are metres; fitBox places its mesh collider from floor y=0. Props spawn static to avoid falling through before floor mesh cooking. Level 2.1 revisioned rebuild preserves generated placement identity; EXIT/DANGER UI panels require width and height attributes in metres to render at their world-panel size.

critter-model.js STYLE_V participates in place.state.bodyStyleV, triggering one place-wide restyle when raised; hair.yml now maps human hair keys to refitted head-fitted pack assets (Tripo rows 14+ no longer selected).
